[SWS_CM_10505] Remote access control on consuming field notifiers
Upstream requirements:
RS_AP_00158
⌈
If a remote subject subscribes to a field notifier , but there exists no
ComFieldGrant
that
• references the subscribing remote subject in the role
remoteSubject
and
• references a
ProvidedApServiceInstance
in the role
serviceInstance
and
• references the field in the role
serviceDeployment
,
then Communication Management shall drop the subscription request.
⌋
